tagline.en: EE MVNO — a £5 / 7GB bundle with a 12-month validity out of the box
tagline.zh: EE虚商——5英镑7GB套餐自带12个月有效期

description.en: TalkHome Mobile is an EE MVNO owned by Nowtel Distribution. Order a £5 7GB eSIM bundle on the official site and the number arrives with 12 months of validity — the longest out-of-the-box keep-alive among budget UK eSIMs, with 7GB of UK data usable during that year.
description.zh: TalkHome Mobile是Nowtel Distribution旗下的EE虚商。官网下单5英镑7GB的eSIM套餐，号码自带12个月有效期——是低价英国eSIM中开箱即得最长的保号周期，且这一年内有7GB英国本地流量可用。

details.en: TalkHome's edge is simplicity: one £5 purchase buys a UK number, 7GB of UK data and a full 12-month validity window — no 30/90-day reorder chore, no balance-change ritual. It runs EE's 2G–5G infrastructure, and its annual plans price well for UK-local use. The trade-off is direction: like other budget MVNOs reviewed alongside it, it is not designed as a mainland-China roaming card — the 7GB is UK-local, so cloud residents using it primarily from China are paying for data they cannot roam cheaply. For a UK number you will actually use in the UK (or keep alive with zero effort for a year), it is the least fussy option reviewed; for China-roaming-first needs, giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink fit better.
details.zh: TalkHome的优势是省心：一次5英镑购入英国号码+7GB英国本地流量+整整12个月有效期——没有30/90天续订义务，也没有余额变动仪式。它走EE的2G-5G网络设施，年付套餐在英国本地使用场景下价格实惠。取舍在方向性：与同批盘点的低价虚商一样，它并非为中国大陆漫游设计——7GB是英国本地流量，主要人在中国的云居民等于花钱买了不便宜漫游的数据。如果你要的是「真会在英国用」或「一年零操心保号」的英国号码，它是本轮盘点中最省事的选择；回国漫游优先则选giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink更合适。

bestFor.en: Set-and-forget users: buy once, valid 12 months, with UK data included.
bestFor.zh: 怕折腾的用户：一次购买、12个月有效、还带英国本地流量。
